notes: Diagonal grid in the NW: Mulberry (NW part), Peete, East Clifton Av., Hurst Alley and McMicken run NW-SE at ~43 deg; Lang and Antique run NE-SW. Lang and Mulberry centrelines follow their water pipes (checked against block lines); Clifton follows its pipe near Main, but near Lang (where it is only 30 ft) the pipe lies ~25 px NE of the band centre, so Lang/Clifton is from block lines; Peete from block lines (two-point line (1172,692)-(2265,1702)). Lang continues past all its crossings onto sheet 162 (NW side shown only as outlines); the NW legs of Peete, Clifton and Hurst are narrow gaps between 162 outline blocks, so marked cross. Lang/McMicken falls off the paper (west of x~265). Antique (printed 'ANTIQUE.', no suffix on sheet or key map; 28') runs from Main SW across Peete to end at East Clifton. Main/Mulberry/Antique is a 5-way junction: two Main/Mulberry T points (diagonal leg y~1102, E-W leg y~1185) plus Antique at y~1142. Mulberry is printed 30' on the diagonal leg near Lang and 60' on the E-W leg (60 listed). East Clifton is printed 30' near Lang but measures ~50 ft near Main (a second label there reads like 55'). McMicken is printed 'McMICKEN AV.' here (building labels 'E. McMICKEN'); named East McMicken Avenue to match sheet 155. Corwine Street is drawn only as a 155 outline gap SW of McMicken (40 ft, with pipe); its T is at (1525,3199). Main/McMicken: McMicken centreline meets Main's north-part centreline at (2275,3910) inside an open plaza (cistern, church tip at (2100,3592)). Sycamore's east line is off the paper; its centre is taken 60 ft (100 px) east of the west block line (pipe is ~35 px west of that), cross-checked against Hughes/Sycamore spacing on sheet 152. Liberty south side is the 152 outline: Long Alley's south leg there is offset to x~2703 and Cogswell's to x~3436, so both are T points (as on 152 Long; 152 had Cogswell as cross). Hughes ends at Liberty (no gap in 152 outline). Scale on this sheet: 50 ft = 169 px. Main's water pipe runs ~15-20 px west of its centreline between Mulberry and Clifton; points use block lines. Main drifts west down the sheet (centre ~2382 at Mulberry, ~2301 at Clifton, ~2285 just north of McMicken).
